text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan, Chrono-chan! Exams are coming 
up, so let's have a study session once we 
get back♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, gladly. I actually wanted to ask 
Love-chan about some applied math problems 
anyway...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Leave anything with numbers to me♪ Of 
course, other things are fine too♡

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
That helps a lot... If there's ever 
anything you need, please feel free to ask 
me too, Love-chan, okay?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, we've gotta go 
buy snacks and drinks for the study 
session♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
They say sugar activates the brain, so 
let's go buy lots of yummy treats♡

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... People might mistake this for a 
sweets party again.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're practically the same thing to 
me♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Either way, having fun together with a 
close friend is what truly matters♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...If so, the same goes for me.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Study sessions with Love-chan are always 
so fun, full of new discoveries and 
delicious treats...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how delightful♪ We truly are meant for 
each other♡
